question: ________ is used to manufacture fertilizers, synthetic fibers, plastics, adhesives, paints, and dyes.
solution:
The correct answer is __**sulphuric acid.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sulphuric acid** is a **highly corrosive and strong acid** used in the production of various industrial chemicals.
 
• **Nitric acid** is also an important industrial chemical used in the production of **fertilizers, explosives, and dyes.**
 
• **Soda ash** is a common name for **sodium carbonate,** which is used in the manufacture of **glass, soaps, and detergents.**
 
• **Alkalis** are a class of chemicals that have a** pH greater than 7** and are used in various applications, including **cleaning agents, water treatment, and food production.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fertilizers **are substances added to soil to** improve plant growth and yield,** and they typically contain **nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium.**
 
• **Synthetic fibers **are man-made materials used in** clothing, upholstery, and other applications,** and they can be produced from various chemicals, including **polyester, nylon, and acrylic.**
 
• **Plastics **are **synthetic materials **that can be molded into various shapes and used in a wide range of products, from packaging to electronics.
 
• **Adhesives** are substances used to** bind two or more surfaces together,** and they can be made from natural or synthetic materials.
 
• **Paints and dyes** are used to add color to various surfaces, including walls, fabrics, and paper.
 
• They can be made from a variety of chemicals, including** pigments, solvents, and binders.**
